# forumulate_forum_category (Resource)

A category of a forum space: its look (colours, icon, logo), who may post and how (approval, slow mode, tags, templates), its defaults for readers, and its names in other languages. Destroying a category is refused by the API while it holds topics; set `delete_move_topics_to` (they move there) or `delete_force` (they are left uncategorised). The topics themselves are never deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forumulate_forum_category" "general" {
  space_id    = forumulate_space.community.id
  name        = "General"
  description = "Talk about anything."
  color       = "0b835b"
  text_color  = "#ffffff"
  emoji       = "💬"

  default_tags = ["welcome"]
  topic_kind   = "discussion"

  translations = {
    es = { name = "General", description = "Habla de lo que quieras." }
  }
}

resource "forumulate_forum_category" "help" {
  space_id                  = forumulate_space.community.id
  name                      = "Help"
  parent_id                 = forumulate_forum_category.general.id
  topic_kind                = "question"
  require_topic_approval    = true
  default_slow_mode_seconds = 30

  # Destroying a category that holds topics moves them first.
  delete_move_topics_to = forumulate_forum_category.general.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The category's name, 1 to 100 characters.
- `space_id` (String) The forum space (its id or slug). Changing it replaces the category.

### Optional

- `about_topic_id` (String) The topic that describes the category (its id).
- `allowed_tags` (Set of String) Only these tags may be used here (up to 50); empty allows any.
- `auto_close_hours` (Number) Close topics this many hours after the last reply (0 to 8760); leave out for never.
- `background_url` (String) A background image, up to 2048 characters.
- `color` (String) The category colour: hex with or without `#` (3, 4, 6 or 8 digits) or a CSS colour name, up to 40 characters. The API stores it normalised.
- `color_dark` (String) The colour in the dark scheme.
- `default_list_filter` (String) `all` or `none`.
- `default_notification_level` (String) What readers are set to by default: `watching`, `watching_first_post`, `tracking`, `normal` or `muted`.
- `default_slow_mode_seconds` (Number) Seconds a member must wait between posts in new topics (0 to 86400).
- `default_sort` (String) How the category is sorted by default: `latest`, `top` or `hot`.
- `default_tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to new topics (up to 12, 60 characters each).
- `default_top_period` (String) `day`, `week`, `month`, `quarter` or `year`.
- `delete_force` (Boolean) On destroy, leave the category's topics uncategorised instead of refusing.
- `delete_move_topics_to` (String) On destroy, move the category's topics to this category (its id) instead of refusing.
- `description` (String) A description, up to 500 characters.
- `emoji` (String) An emoji for the category (user content). Up to 16 characters.
- `expert_user_ids` (Set of String) Users whose answers count as expert (up to 20 user ids).
- `icon` (String) A named icon, or a custom icon (a path or URL with a scheme).
- `locale` (String) The category's language, a code like en or pt-br.
- `logo_url` (String) A logo: an uploaded path or an http(s) URL, up to 2048 characters.
- `minimum_required_tags` (Number) How many tags a new topic must carry, 0 to 12.
- `navigate_to_first_post` (Boolean) Open topics at their first post instead of the last unread.
- `num_featured_topics` (Number) How many topics the category page features, 0 to 50.
- `parent_id` (String) The parent category's id; leave out for a top-level category.
- `post_guidelines` (String) Shown to people composing a topic, up to 2000 characters.
- `require_reply_approval` (Boolean) New replies wait for a moderator.
- `require_topic_approval` (Boolean) New topics wait for a moderator.
- `required_tag_groups` (Attributes List) Tag groups a topic must draw tags from (up to 20). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--required_tag_groups))
- `search_priority` (String) `very_low`, `low`, `normal`, `high` or `very_high`.
- `show_subcategory_list` (Boolean) Whether the category page lists its subcategories.
- `slug` (String) The category's address segment (up to 100 characters). Derived from the name when left out.
- `sort_ascending` (Boolean) Sort the default order ascending.
- `sort_order` (Number) Position among siblings, 0 to 9999.
- `style` (String) How the category is marked: `square`, `icon`, `emoji` or `none`.
- `subcategory_list_style` (String) `rows`, `boxes` or `chips`.
- `text_color` (String) The text colour drawn on `color`. The API warns when the pair is under WCAG AA contrast.
- `text_color_dark` (String) The text colour in the dark scheme.
- `topic_kind` (String) `question` files new topics as questions (Q&A look); `discussion` as discussions.
- `topic_template_json` (String) A template new topics start from (a JSON object). A JSON document: write it with `jsonencode()`. Drift is detected only for the keys you declare, so settings someone else manages are left alone.
- `translations` (Attributes Map) The category's name and description in other languages. Keyed by language code (`es`, `pt-br`). Replaced whole when changed; remove the attribute to clear them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--translations))
- `voting_enabled` (Boolean) Let readers vote on topics here.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The category's id (a UUID).
- `topic_count` (Number) How many topics the category holds.

<a id="nestedatt--required_tag_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `required_tag_groups`

Required:

- `min_count` (Number) How many tags from the group, 1 to 12.
- `tag_group_id` (String) The tag group's id.


<a id="nestedatt--translations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `translations`

Optional:

- `description` (String) The description in this language (up to 2000 characters).
- `name` (String) The name in this language (up to 200 characters).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import forumulate_forum_category.general community/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
